title: Finally something that works
body:
I suffer from being unorganized, haven’t been diagnosed but I have trouble keeping important to-do:s in mind, forgetting things when I leave home, hard to plan my day realistically and even making it out the door on time in the morning. I have big issues with my discipline. 

I have tried different systems and apps. Nothing works. But Me+ helps! It’s easy to use and have a “light” and positive feel. There are several suggestions to buy therapy in the app, but since I can’t afford that  I simply don’t click on those links. After a while you remember where those links pop up and they’re no longer disturbing. Since I’m so happy with the app maybe I will try the therapy when and if I need it and can afford it. 

The reminders in the app aren’t annoying like in other apps. There are multiple resources that come with the subscription, and you can access step by step questions when you feel lonely and lost, ending with a helpful (not just perky) message to keep you going. 

You may think I work for Me+ after this review! I don’t, but I’m grateful that there are aids for those of us with good intentions and messy minds. 
If you organize your daily tasks properly in the app and not overdo it (every task comes with the option to list subtasks, this helps to keep the daily routine clean) you will be able to look at your list, consider the time you have and choose your top three important things to do (remember no one has time for everything). Then you will feel content when you go to bed even if you didn’t manage to get it all done. 

At first the app seems simplified but give it a few days, and you’ll get it. Hope this helps!
